title: PRD-01 synthetic risk input syntax

vehicleRef.description: required; owned or delegated vehicle record. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: VEHICLE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

plate.description: conditional on approved inquiry; 1–20 characters; format from jurisdiction profile. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: PLATE_FORMAT_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

vehicleClass.description: required; versioned carrier-compatible classification. Sensitivity: internal. Error: VEHICLE_CLASS_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

usageCode.description: required; 1–40 characters from product form. Sensitivity: internal. Error: USAGE_NOT_OFFERED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

priorPolicyRef.description: optional; authorized policy or verified uploaded evidence. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: PRIOR_POLICY_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

noClaimHistoryRef.description: conditional for discount; provenance, as-of time and inquiry version required. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: NO_CLAIM_EVIDENCE_STALE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

liabilityPlanCode.description: required; 1–40 characters; offered plan snapshot. Sensitivity: internal. Error: LIABILITY_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
